item.title: Lamar Jackson: Could miss multiple games
item.description:
Jackson (ankle) is not dealing with a long-term injury, but he has "only an outside chance to play" in Week 5 and "could end up missing multiple games," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

item.title: Kyle Pitts: Uptick in production during big win
item.description:
Pitts secured all three targets for 47 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

item.title: Juwan Johnson: Stays busy in Week 4 loss
item.description:
Johnson secured six of eight targets for 59 yards in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday night.

item.title: Alvin Kamara: Two rush TDs in return to lead role
item.description:
Kamara rushed seven times for 23 yards and two touchdowns and brought in five of seven targets for 35 yards in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday night.

item.title: Brian Robinson: Racks up three TDs in win
item.description:
Robinson rushed 14 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns and brought in his sole target for five yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.
